output.semantics: CenterFace heatmap, scale, offset and five-landmark tensors exposed as ONNX outputs 537, 538, 539 and 540. The pinned upstream ONNX graph is executed through OpenCV DNN because its static input metadata is incompatible with ONNX Runtime dynamic image sizes; this matches the upstream CenterFace reference runtime. The adapter downsizes only when the source long edge exceeds 1600 pixels, rounds each tensor dimension up to a multiple of 32, decodes stride-4 boxes and landmarks, and applies deterministic NMS.
